description: Figure 8 shows the distribution of refusal categories on FACTBENCH. The figure includes four pie charts, each representing a different language model (LM). The pie charts are labeled as GPT4-o, Gemini 1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-708-Instruct, and Llama3.1-4058-Instruct. Each pie chart is divided into several categories, including "Lack of Knowledge," "Ethical Advice," "Certification," and "Other." The "Lack of Knowledge" category is the largest in all four pie charts, followed by "Ethical Advice." The "Certification" category is the smallest, and the "Other" category is also relatively small. The pie charts are color-coded, with each category represented by a different color. The figure also includes a note that Gemini 1.5-Pro has the highest number of refusals across a broad range of categories, and that GPT4-o produced a fully hallucinated response.
